newsitem.title: USA: BioSource sees Q2 earnings below estimates.
newsitem.headline: BioSource sees Q2 earnings below estimates.

text.p: BioSource International Inc said Friday that foreign exchange pressures may cause revenues and earnings for its second quarter to fall below analysts expectations.

Analysts had expected the company would earn $0.10 in its second quarter, ended June 30, according to First Call. The company had profits of $590,900, or $0.09 a share, on revenues of $3.26 million in the comparable year-ago period.
The company said the exchange rate of U.S. dollars relative to the German Mark and Belgian Franc may result in European revenues about 15 percent below analysts' estimates.

About half of the BioSource's revenues are generated in Europe. BioSource said it expects sales of new products, such as the recently introduced ViralQuant-CMV assay, may make up most, if not all, of the revenue shortfall expected as a result of the currency differentiation by the end of the current fiscal year.
